The master tried running the section on the emergency generator.
The notification to the company was four hours late.

I want to be accurate about this. I did not ignore the alarm. I watched it for two minutes. I decided it was the sensor, and then I stopped watching it. What I did not do, and what I regret, is stop to read the fault code. It takes fifteen seconds. The code would have told me the fault was in the circuit, and I would have called the engine room one hour earlier. Yes, I was on watch for eleven hours. That is not an excuse. Many people work eleven hours and read the code. I remember signing the checklist. I do not remember checking a single item on it.
